scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: On TUM fr3_walking_xyz at K=1, R6 (0.1420m) substantially outperforms R3 random (0.2980m) and R4 visual uncertainty (0.3450m). However, on D455 at K=5, R6 alone fails (F1=0.0) because inlier count selects static landmarks, whereas R5 geometry uncertainty succeeds (F1=0.75).
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Evaluate on multi-sequence benchmarks with independent moving objects to measure consistency across varying landmark densities.

scientific_claim_verdicts.claim: R7 adds value beyond estimator-state-only selection
scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: At TUM K=1, R7 is mathematically and empirically identical to R6 (both 0.1420m, zero incremental gain). At TUM K=3, R7 (0.0182m) outperforms R6 (0.0520m) by motion-gating static high-inlier chairs. On D455 K=5, R7 achieves parity with R5 geometry uncertainty (both F1=0.75), providing no incremental advantage.
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Independent sequence replications and component ablation isolating whether velocity gating generalizes beyond fr3_walking_xyz.

scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: On D455, VLM physical affordance classification successfully eliminates 2 false positive relocation proposals (door_001 and operator), improving precision from 0.60 to 1.00.
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Broader evaluation on visually degraded or partially occluded candidate crops (e.g., OpenLORIS long-range pedestrian failure).

scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: R7 reaches 0.0182m with 3 queries (91.9s latency) vs 0.3497m baseline, avoiding exhaustive 10-query latency (323.7s). Frame tracking coverage is 96.28% (827/859 frames).
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Cross-sequence evaluation across multiple dynamic TUM sequences (fr2_desk, fr3_sitting). Currently restricted to single-sequence within-sample comparison (N=1).

scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: OpenLORIS localization was NOT improved over baseline (1.7045m vs 1.7045m). Selective conservative retention merely avoided the degradation caused by aggressive geometry-only masking (1.7867m).
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Sequences with dynamic objects in feature-rich environments where selective masking can improve tracking without feature starvation.

scientific_claim_verdicts.claim: Selective querying improves D455 map integrity
scientific_claim_verdicts.comparison: Multi-session anchor residual vs Unmitigated baseline
scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: Resolving 3 relocated objects reduces held-out anchor residual to 12.42 cm (against 11.98 cm noise floor) with 5 queries vs 41 exhaustive queries (93.7% latency reduction).
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Physical multi-room deployment beyond two recording sessions.

scientific_claim_verdicts.comparison: Sufficiency audit and held-out cross-sequence validation
scientific_claim_verdicts.evidence: Strict candidate-level independent intervention sample size is N=2 (well below required N=30). Development sequences N=3 (below required N=5). Fitting a parameterized regression model was correctly blocked by the sufficiency gate.
scientific_claim_verdicts.remaining_requirement: Generation of at least 30 independent single-candidate counterfactual interventions across at least 5 independent sequences.
